brief_corrections: Adjusted edge Jaccard is weighted per video by TP+FP+FN, not by the GT edge count (tools/official/metrics.md 'w_i = TP_i + FP_i + FN_i'; metrics.py summarise(); h_metric-math.json challenged_assumptions; browser_intel.md s.5 'weight-averaged by (TP+FP+FN)').

'Fewer nodes than N_est is a bonus' is misleading: the node multiplier is linear with no kink and no cap above 1, so every node costs 0.1*J_i/N_est_i on either side of N_est and N_est is irrelevant to decisions (h_metric-math.json, synthetic check N_est=2*N_pred -> adj 1.05; browser_intel.md s.5 'scores can exceed 1.0').

LB noise '~0.003' does not apply to deterministic kernels: 241 teams sit at exactly 0.953 (browser_intel.md s.6.0C histogram), exp54 is byte-identical to exp48 and exp56 reproduced x138's counts exactly (browser s.6.0B). The 0.946/0.942 pair came from notebooks with an in-kernel PP sweep that scores DIFFERENT train stems on the hidden rerun (imissher, discussion 743222; h_redteam-past.json). Resolution on the public embryo is the 0.001 display step; the real uncertainty is public (one embryo, 29%) -> private (71%, other embryos).

LB state is stale in BRIEF: at 11:00-11:27 UTC 25 Sep there are 241 (not 41) teams at exactly 0.953, 401 >= 0.953, 39-41 >= 0.960, 6 >= 0.970, top 0.975; we are rank ~456 at 0.950; the 0.954-0.956 shoulder grew to 47/28/19 teams; no public notebook scores above 0.953 (browser_intel.md s.1, s.2, s.6.0C).

Hidden test size: the Data tab says 'approximately the same size as the training dataset' (~199 clips; browser_intel.md s.5), while CONTEXT.md l.14 estimated 100-130 from scoring-time ratios. Runtime must be planned for N up to ~200. Note (s_merge arithmetic): x138's own public 0.953 (241 identical copies) and exp51's <= 7.5 h submit-to-score latency (#31 17:09 -> 00:39, same GPU phase) bound N*(~132 s GPU per clip on 2 shards + repair) <= ~27,000 s at dummy speed, i.e. N <~ 140 unless the hidden hardware is faster; the browser's '7.4 h GPU phase for 199 clips' projection is contradicted by x138 scoring 0.953.

The probe rule '#35 > #34 -> x138 + insertion is F1' is unsafe: in exp57b the divinsert block (experiments/exp57b_x138_divins_only/exp57b-x138-divins-only.ipynb code line ~4648) is gated only by BIOHUB_DIVINS_ENABLE, not by _deadline_degraded; BIOHUB_DIVINS_DUMP=1 writes an npz per clip; repair took 491 s vs 227 s on the 4 dummies (browser_intel.md s.6.11). Past REPAIR_DEADLINE_S=27000 the alphabetically later datasets lose relink/readmit/gaps/safe divisions/linefit (~-0.05..-0.065 each, v_ensembles-and-private_x138-budget-aware-deadline_value.json) while insertion keeps running. #35's public score can therefore be confounded by the guard, and its private score can be degraded even when public looks fine.

x138's +0.007 head gain is not all localisation: final nodes fall 2.4-2.9% (ext_x138/DIFF.md s.4), worth ~+0.0022-0.0027 through the node multiplier, so the localisation share is ~+0.004 and itself a single LB difference (h_metric-math, h_redteam-past, h_detector-retrain, h_linking-on-x138 challenged_assumptions).
Public division J 0.36 is an upper estimate: probe 26 (safe divisions off) also removed the second-daughter edges, so part of the 0.036 drop is edge J (h_redteam-past.json).
a_never (node never produced) is 1,907/6,732 = 28.3% of lab FN, not ~31% (experiments/l2_daughternet/edge_anatomy/fn_anatomy_exp39.md; v_metric-math_readmit-recall-knobs_value.json).

'READMIT of discarded peaks' is incomplete: READMIT_MIN_SCORE 0.965 equals the detection threshold, so readmitted nodes are ILP-discarded ABOVE-threshold peaks that re-enter as UNREFINED int16 grid copies (the head had refined them before the ILP); only the gap filler uses 0.5-0.965 peaks (x138 cells 0/4/5; v_kaggle-intel_refine-lowdet-pool_*.json, v_linking-on-x138_refined-lowdet-pool_*.json).

The head-retrain closure stands, but for a different reason than BRIEF gives: the kill test's comparator was in-embryo (public head trained on ~10+10 stems), yet per-embryo leak5 OOF shows the 199-video heads are WORSE than the public head on 44b6 even at equal exposure (P 1.343 vs 1.296 um, +3.6%; Q +3.9%, beats public on only 20/71 44b6 videos); the pooled -19% is a 6bba effect (v_redteam-past_head199-x138-two-arm_value.json, v_github-intel_head-blend_schedule.json).

DeepCenter (the safe-division and gap veto) was trained on the 71 44b6 clips only; its val set is the 128 6bba clips (split_manifest, browser_intel.md s.6.1 item 2), so 6bba is an honest test bed for any DeepCenter-threshold decision; BRIEF's lab caveat does not apply to that component.

Lab infrastructure is thinner than BRIEF implies: the 199-video head captures hold 224-d features only for 313,205 near-GT peaks (+1% sample) of 4.83M peaks, so they cannot drive a CPU x138-tail lab; friend A's queued cache (raw/ckpt/dc/divnet, replay.py) has no flow relink, readmit, gap filler or lowdet dump; friend A has made no commits since 24 Sep 04:12 MSK. Any honest x138 lab must be a Kaggle x138-on-train kernel (v_linking-on-x138_x138-tail-lab-headcoords_schedule.json, v_redteam-past_x138-tail-recalibration-refined-coords_schedule.json).

In x138 every final edge comes from a one-to-one flow-prior Hungarian (filter_output_graph sets edges = motion_edges); the ILP emits 0 forks, so safe divisions are the only fork source and OUTPUT_DIVISION_GEOMETRY_FILTER is off (h_linking-on-x138.json, h_divisions.json, v_linking-on-x138_split-aware-flow-relink_schedule.json).

Top-team evidence is unchanged since 24 Sep: no top-10 post in 10 days beyond Ogurtsov one-liners; Tang (6th, 0.970) recommends retraining; nobody has published a retrained detector, edge or division model that beats 0.953 (browser_intel.md s.2, s.3, s.6.11).

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: BRIEF: adjusted edge is weighted by GT edge count; predicting fewer nodes than N_est is a special bonus region.
assumptions_adjudicated.why: Official summarise() weights by TP+FP+FN; the multiplier is linear with no kink or cap (synthetic check in h_metric-math.json; browser_intel.md s.5). Harmless for ranking, but lab re-implementations must use D_i and every node has the same marginal price.

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: x138's +0.007 over readmit-v1 measures what better localisation is worth (positions consumed by the post-ILP chain).
assumptions_adjudicated.why: Final nodes drop 2.4-2.9% with the head (DIFF.md s.4) = ~+0.0022-0.0027 of multiplier; 7 um re-match counts move <= 0.1% for every head (out_full_P/report.txt). The localisation share (~+0.004) is a single LB difference; on our base the head gave +0.002, i.e. ~all multiplier. Raised independently by 6 lenses.

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: LB noise is ~+-0.003 per run, so single-probe deltas below 0.005 are not decisions.
assumptions_adjudicated.why: Our kernels and x138 are deterministic (241 teams at exactly 0.953; exp54 == exp48 byte-for-byte; exp56 == x138 counts). The 0.946/0.942 pair came from leaky in-kernel sweeps (imissher 743222). A 0.001 public step is a real public-embryo effect; what stays uncertain is transfer to the 71% private embryos, which skeptics mislabelled as 'noise'. Effects of +0.0002-0.0005 remain invisible at the 0.001 display step.

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: Hidden test ~100-130 clips (CONTEXT l.14) vs ~199 (Data tab; browser projection 7.4 h GPU phase).
assumptions_adjudicated.why: Data tab says 'approximately the same size as the training dataset'. But x138's public 0.953 requires public datasets to be fully repaired, and exp51 (same GPU phase, no guard) scored within 7.5 h of submission, which bounds N at ~140 at dummy speed (265 s/clip/shard, 2 shards). Either N ~100-140 or the hidden hardware is faster. Plan runtime for N up to 200.

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: x138 verbatim is a safe finals base because 41 (now 241) teams reproduce 0.953.
assumptions_adjudicated.why: Identical public scores prove only that public datasets were not degraded (a firing guard would jitter the score between runs). The guard (REPAIR_DEADLINE_S 27000, sorted dataset order) can still degrade alphabetically late private datasets; heavier variants (exp57b: +66 s/clip ungated insertion) cross it sooner. Also, a byte-identical copy ties 240 earlier copies on private and loses the submission-time tie-break.

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: The 199-video V1284 head failed its kill test only because the test was biased (in-embryo comparator, offset-dominated metric), so it should be re-opened.
assumptions_adjudicated.why: The test design was flawed, but skeptics split the leak5 OOF per embryo: on 44b6 the new heads are 3.6-3.9% worse than the public head even at equal exposure; the -19% gain is 6bba-only; debiased Q loses to public in both embryo directions; a 50/50 blend is bounded by convexity at +1.6-2% worse on 44b6. The closure stands (v_redteam-past_head199-x138-two-arm_value.json, v_github-intel_head-blend_*.json, v_detector-retrain_coordhead-v2-embryo-robust_value.json).

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: v2: the lab's division numbers (J 0.12, precision 0.35) calibrate division decisions; 'keep cap 4' carries over to x138.
assumptions_adjudicated.why: Public J ~0.36 needs precision >= 0.40 and sets the break-even for an added fork at J/(1+J) = 0.265 vs ~0.11 in the lab; removals of FP forks are positive under both. But no re-tune survived: tightening is ~#34, loosening had a 0 TP / +2 FP lab marginal, and ~3% of insertions are evaluable (~5 public events), so the x138 cap question is moot rather than answered.

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: Public division J = 0.36 exactly.
assumptions_adjudicated.why: Probe 26 removed the safe-division stage including second-daughter edges, so 0.036 mixes 0.1*div_J with an edge-J change; 0.36 is an upper estimate (h_redteam-past.json).

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: Divisions are the only big untapped term / the top teams win on divisions.
assumptions_adjudicated.why: Division headroom at realistic precision is +0.002-0.005; the gap to 0.970 is mostly adjusted edge (~0.91 for us vs ~0.93-0.94 needed). Forum: div J ~0.28 at adj 0.89 (Lime1123); hikaggler's trained division head gave +-0.001 LB (browser 741749).

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: v2: ceiling ~0.962; 0.97 unreachable by 29 Sep (and 0.99 is the target).
assumptions_adjudicated.why: Every lens concluded 0.99 is unreachable (it would need adjusted edge ~0.95 plus div J ~0.4 on unseen embryos, above the LB top 0.975). All 44 ideas' realistic public gains are <= +0.001 except the runtime insurance; the only evidence-backed route to 0.97 (retraining, Tang/Civitasmass) was refuted for this window by 10/10 skeptic files. The hunters' objection to v2's reasoning (sum of kept ceilings is not a problem ceiling) is correct, but the conclusion holds.

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: Retraining is impossible in time / does not pay (BRIEF: scratch 0.920, fine-tunes 0.944/0.943).
assumptions_adjudicated.why: For 29 Sep: 7/7 detector swaps on our LB were negative; exp11's LOEO +0.0027 was a node artefact (matched-node edge J -0.0015); Kai-Gowers' 400-epoch retrain 0.927 vs 0.942; leonixis 0.947; dense Ultrack teachers (97.2% <= 7 um) are weaker than the student (0.988). P(gated scored probe) 0.03-0.2. The scratch-0.920 argument itself was weak (undertrained secondary), but the conclusion stands.

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: External/dorado data is a closed line (BRIEF lists dorado-only DaughterNet).
assumptions_adjudicated.why: Only the division classifier was closed; no detector was ever trained on dense Ultrack labels. The detector variants were then refuted on value/time (C11), so the practical outcome is the same for 29 Sep.

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: 44b6 clips are overlapping crops of the Ultrack dorado recording (BRIEF) vs Sergio Alvarez (1st): dorado is 'not the same embryos used in training, but very similar'.
assumptions_adjudicated.why: Our registration (tools/register_44b6_dorado.py: 84% of 44b6 GT within 2.5 um of dorado Ultrack points at the right time offset vs 5-11% at wrong offsets; 62 clip pairs share 2,429 GT nodes) is a measurement; Sergio's line is an opinion (browser_intel.md 741386).

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: The ~2,700 swap-type FN are node-position errors that better localisation can harvest (+0.03-0.046 oracle).
assumptions_adjudicated.why: Swap GT sits 4.4/4.7 um from two of our tracks 9.4 um apart, beyond the head's 2 um range; 4-6 um holes are the same blob in 95-99% of cases (valley test); motion prefers our link in 98.6%; snapping to Ultrack lowered the <4 um share 0.927 -> 0.908. It reads as annotation convention/missing-node, not sub-voxel error (h_localisation-training-free.json, h_linking-on-x138.json).

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: Sub-voxel / full-resolution localisation (polyphase, parabola, watershed centroid, image z-offset) is still an open lever after x138.
assumptions_adjudicated.why: Challenged by redteam (v2 bound excluded x138's tail), but every measured analogue is <= 0: float output lab +0.0019 -> LB tie twice; Eric's sub-voxel refinement +0.0078 local -> -0.002 LB twice; constant offset -0.0031; per-video GT-oracle z shift gave no match gain; z carries 66% of error variance and full-res adds no z information. The lever is closed in practice (C09 keeps only CPU desk tests).

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: Lab gains transfer when the change does not lean on network confidence.
assumptions_adjudicated.why: Float output (pure geometry) lab +0.0019 on 199 videos -> LB tie twice; insertion lab +0.0019 -> LB +0.001. The in-sample detector places train peaks closer to GT than test peaks, so geometric lab gains are inflated too; the sign of the bias depends on the change (fragment rescue is under-stated in-sample).

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: B35 (full-frame 0.90 daughter pass) failed because +24% nodes blow the node budget.
assumptions_adjudicated.why: +24% was the CANDIDATE pool, not output nodes (each accepted fork adds <= 1 node), and x138 already dumps peaks >= 0.3. But the revived mirror/lowdet-daughter ideas are still ~0 (17% not 27% addressable; merged-blob c1 defeats mirror geometry), so the practical closure stands for other reasons.

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: Lowering the detection threshold is closed, so sub-threshold peaks carry no value.
assumptions_adjudicated.why: Persistence-gated admission (BYTE/hysteresis) was never tested, but public anchors on the same pool and embryo say value density in the 0.5-0.965 band is <= 0: gapfill 0.947 -> 0.947, readmit -> 0.946, det 0.965 -> 0.95 flat, min track len 4 -0.002; the ILP already selects band nodes at zero node cost. The x138 dummy logs show the free pool is 142% and 30% of final nodes on 2/4 clips (junk-dominated).

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: Every node in x138 carries head-refined float coordinates.
assumptions_adjudicated.why: The lowdet pool is dumped before _v1284_refine and cast to int16 (x138 cell 4 'lowdet peaks'/'lowdet write'); readmit and gapfill write those lattice positions (1,337 readmitted of 121,777 raw nodes on the dummies). Fix = C05 (refine only the >= 0.965 part).

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: Extra seeds/TTA views can be added freely inside the 12 h limit.
assumptions_adjudicated.why: For x138 the binding budget is the 7.5 h repair guard, not 12 h: GPU phase ~265 s/clip/shard; at N~130 exp56 finishes ~6.9 h (0.6 h margin). Any extra GPU pass (third detector, simview, precision detector, dense copy) pushes late datasets into degraded mode unless C01 is applied.

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: Relink/linefit/gate knobs are a closed line (closed on integer-grid coordinates).
assumptions_adjudicated.why: The noise model did change (head shift 0.74 um), but ~2/3 of the head's squared-error drop is a constant offset that cancels in displacements; the B28 curvature puts a re-weighting at ~+0.0001-0.0003. Only one pre-registered linefit arm (w0.7, win2) survives, inside C06's lab.

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: Leaf prune on x138 is closed because it removes readmitted nodes.
assumptions_adjudicated.why: The mechanism is that every non-ILP pair gets edge_prob 0.0 (not only readmits); a neutral-probability fix is confidence-leaning and its ceiling is the +0.0006 lab gain. Not retested; not worth a slot.

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: 'ILP division weight is closed (probe 3 neutral)'.
assumptions_adjudicated.why: Probe 3 could not reach the output (ILP emits 0 forks; relink rebuilds edges one-to-one), so the test was invalid. But the direct in-sample evidence of the edge network's pairwise division signal is weak (exp12 ILP forks 24 TP / 103 FP = 0.19 precision, below the 0.265 break-even), so re-opening is not justified.

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: Dummy-test kernel runtimes can judge the hidden-test budget.
assumptions_adjudicated.why: Whole-kernel dummy times vary ~1.5x between identical-compute runs (exp51 29 min vs exp52 43 min). Only per-dataset log lines are informative; the browser supplied them (detection+edges 214-268 s/clip/shard, ILP 5-90 s, repair 10-110 s x138 / 19-276 s exp57b).

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: thtennant's private 0.959 is x138 plus knobs, so nothing can be learned from him / a successor will be published.
assumptions_adjudicated.why: He likely reached 0.959 without V1284 (head public only on 24 Sep 03:04; separate team), which implies an unpublished lever, but he has published nothing since 19 Sep and silver-zone incentives argue against release (browser s.6.0C: Tennant #47 0.959). C10 keeps only a triggered watch.

assumptions_adjudicated.assumption: AdaBN was correctly rejected (-0.0066 on the public stack) and intensity-augmentation fine-tunes hurt (exp14).
assumptions_adjudicated.why: Both rejections used in-sample videos (the public weights memorised them), so the closure reasons are biased; but the only honest AdaBN test also showed node inflation, and neither was re-proposed as a candidate. Not re-tested; no action by 29 Sep.
